privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicyPage.intro: This page explains what information FFXIV Rotation Calculator ("this tool") handles, how it is used, how long it is kept and how to request its deletion.

operator.heading: Operator
operator.body: This tool is run by {{name}}, an individual developer.

stored.heading: Information stored on the server
stored.intro: The following information is stored in a Cloudflare database (D1).
stored.timelines: The content you save with "Save & share" (job, level, placed skills, stats and so on) and its title. Anyone with the share URL can view it.
stored.ownerHash: A value that identifies the browser that saved a timeline. The token itself is not stored.
stored.discordIdLabel: Value derived from your Discord user ID
stored.discordId: Stored when you log in with Discord. This tool asks Discord only for the identify scope, and of the information it receives, it uses only your user ID (your username and avatar are not stored, and your email address is not received). Your user ID itself is not stored either: the tool stores its HMAC-SHA256, computed with a key that only the operator holds. The same ID always gives the same value, so the tool can recognize your account the next time you log in, but your ID cannot be found from the value (when a deletion request arrives, the operator computes the value from the ID of the requester to find it).
stored.accountLink: When you log in, timelines saved in that browser are linked to your account, so they also appear in your list when you log in from another browser.
stored.sessions: A hash of the value that keeps you logged in, and its expiry.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.intro: This tool sets the following three cookies. They are used only for saving and logging in, not for advertising or analytics.
cookies.owner: Identifies the owner of saved timelines. Its expiry is extended each time you save, view your list or delete, and it expires 400 days after it was last used. It is also deleted when you log out.
cookies.session: Keeps you logged in. It expires after 30 days (extended while you use the tool, up to 1 year). It is deleted when you log out.
cookies.discordOauth: Used only while you log in with Discord. It holds values that verify the login (state and code_verifier) and the page to return to after logging in. It expires after 10 minutes and is deleted when you return from Discord.

browserStorage.heading: Information kept only in your browser
browserStorage.body: The timeline you are editing, your settings and recently used jobs are kept in your browser's localStorage. The only thing sent to the server is a timeline you save with "Save & share".

external.heading: External services
external.cloudflare: Hosts this tool and its database. When you open a page or save, your IP address and browser information are passed to Cloudflare.
external.turnstile: Used for bot protection when you open the save dialog. Your IP address, browser information and similar data are passed to Cloudflare.
external.discord: Used for logging in. When you log in, this tool receives your user information from Discord (it uses only your user ID, and stores only a value derived from it).
external.googleFonts: Used to display text. When you open a page, your IP address and browser information are passed to Google.

use.heading: How information is used
use.body: The information is used only to save, share, list and delete timelines and to log you in. It is not used for advertising or analytics, and it is not sold or given to third parties (except where required by law).

retention.heading: Retention
retention.timelines: Saved timelines have no expiry. When you delete one, it no longer appears in your list or at its share URL, but the data remains on the server. To erase it completely, send a request as described in "Deletion requests" below.
retention.account: The value derived from your Discord user ID and the links to your account also have no expiry and are kept until you request their deletion.
retention.sessions: Login sessions expire after 30 days (extended while you use the tool, up to 1 year) and can no longer be used. Their records are deleted when you log out, and records of sessions that expired without logging out are deleted once a day.
retention.backup: So that the database can be restored if it breaks, it is backed up daily, and the newest 30 backups (normally 30 days' worth) are kept on a device the operator manages. Erased data normally disappears from the backups after about 30 days.

deletion.heading: Deletion requests
deletion.how: Send a friend request to {{discord}} on Discord, then send your request by DM.
deletion.account: The value derived from the user ID, the links and the sessions of the Discord account that sent the request are erased. If you also want the timelines linked to your account erased, say so in your request.
deletion.anonymous: First delete the timeline from "Saved timelines" in this tool, then send your request with its share URL. Only timelines that have already been deleted are erased completely (only the owner can delete a timeline in this tool, so this confirms that you are the owner).
deletion.copies: Copies that other people saved from your timeline (by opening its share URL and saving) are their own saves and are not erased.
